@graph.description: Granola vs Fathom for US teams in 2026: bot vs bot-free capture, free plans, real prices, CRM sync and privacy compared, plus when a third option fits better.

itemListElement.name: Granola vs Fathom in 2026: Which Fits US Teams Better?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Granola vs Fathom debate, Granola is better for private, bot-free notes that start from what you type. Fathom is better for recording calls, sharing clips and syncing to a CRM. Neither is better for every team.
Yes. Fathom's free plan includes unlimited recordings and transcriptions plus instant AI summaries. Some AI features carry a "limited use" tag, and Premium costs $16 a month billed yearly.
Granola has a free Basic plan with AI notes and chat, but it keeps only 30 days of meeting history. Business costs $14 per user per month and removes the history limit.

mainEntity.name: Does Granola record video like Fathom?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Granola transcribes your computer's audio and writes notes, but it does not record video. Fathom records video and lets you clip and share moments.

mainEntity.name: Which works better for Google Meet and Zoom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both work with Zoom and Google Meet. Fathom joins as a recorder, while Granola captures audio from your desktop app on Mac or Windows. Fathom also supports Microsoft Teams.

mainEntity.name: What is a good alternative to both Granola and Fathom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk combines bot and bot-free capture, in-person recording, and follow-up work like Jira tickets.
